title: Tensor-route transport for an explicit ordinary monoidal structure
statement: For prime ℓ, normed E over ℚ_ℓ, f:X→Y, an explicit monoidal structure m on ordinary integral pullback, a proof that pullback preserves flat objects, and a homotopy complex P of integral module sheaves on Y, the residue exchange tensor comparison equation holds with the derived monoidal structure induced by m and flatness.

proof.text: Transport the generic tensor-route factorization through the residue exchange interface, the canonical tensor presentation, and the derived monoidal structure induced by the explicit ordinary monoidal input m.

proof_origin.note: Strictly more general transport statement split from the target after dependent instance normalization blocked direct reduction.

mathlib_searches.results: Generic derived tensor comparison declarations inspected.
Existing residue tensor model declarations inspected.

theorem integralResidue_tensorRoute_model_transport {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (m : (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧.Monoidal)
    (hFlat : (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧.PreservesFlat)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) (.up ℤ)) :
    letI := residueExchangePullMonoidal ℓ E f m hFlat
    (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).map
          ((residueExchangeTensorIso ℓ E Y).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
        Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f)
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P) (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y) ≫
        residueExchangeTensorModelTarget ℓ E f P =
      residueExchangeTensorModelMap ℓ E f P
